A GLOBAL QUANTUM MOMENT THEOREM FOR AUTONOMOUS TANNER REPAIR
1 November 2026. Solo proof candidate, based on explicit primary code-family
inputs and DENSITY_LEMMA.txt. Independent audit and priority review pending.

What changes
--------------
This changes the architecture from geometric Toom erosion to a bounded-
connectivity quantum Tanner code. There is NO supplied healthy exterior,
periodic recovery layer, fictitious stochastic fault process or noise floor.
The representation is a positive exponential moment of the ACTUAL quantum
syndrome potential. A finite density of ordinary defects is allowed; only
the extensive decoding boundary must remain unlikely.

The result is graph-local, not geometrically local in 2D, 3D or 4D. Both
CSS sectors and all k=Omega(n) logical qubits are retained together. The
original active/completed Toom phase problem is not thereby solved.

 rho=alpha/[4(1+2c)],                 r=floor(rho n).

For each CSS sector use the sum of local distances to its dual tensor code.
Let U=U_X+U_Z. Each nonnegative integer U_v is supported on Q(v), bounded
by c and computed from the local commuting stabilizers. All the U_v commute.
Each data qubit belongs to exactly four such potential terms in total.

syndrome has summed reduced CSS weight within alpha n. Its soundness bound
is w_X+w_Z<=c U for weights <=alpha n/(1+2c).

THE PHYSICAL ARCHITECTURE CHANGE AND ITS COSTS
1 November 2026. No hardware or external state was changed.

What is constructed mathematically
------------------------------------
A family of static, bounded-graph-local Lindbladians on positive-rate,
linear-distance quantum Tanner codes. Local writes are chosen by a fixed
syndrome truth table that lowers the Gu--Pattison--Tang potential. Both
CSS sectors run continuously with independent local generator terms.
No global round, schedule, repeated global decoder, perfect stored
syndrome register, free measurement, physical reset, or added noise floor
appears. One may choose the ACTIVE generator; completed proposal channels
are a separately counted alternative, not a free proof replacement.

The robust quantum conclusion covers every encoded qubit and arbitrary
initial logical/bath/reference correlations under the actual continuous
joint dynamics. It is stronger than the one-plane transverse-fault model
in noise class, but it changes the code and its interaction geometry.
The original Toom theorem, island return, delayed strip, native-bath result
and quantum-record alternative remain preserved and separate.

The local Markovian repair reservoir is an ASSUMED physical resource at
rate kappa. Its laboratory synthesis and entropy-removal/work costs have
not been derived. Writing down its local jump operators is the code-level
construction, not physical acquisition of dissipation or a controller.
